lines.text: Frost on the window. A tired DAD shivers at the stove.
He tips Hearth Oats from a red pack into a small pot.
His sleepy DAUGHTER shuffles in, coat over pyjamas, one wellington boot.
Steam rises and softens the window. His shoulders drop.
He sets a warm bowl before her. She sighs.
He sits beside her and eats from her bowl. She lets him.
Hearth Oats. Slow down, warm up.

writes.note: I cut the scene to six short beats and the VO line, about 14.4 s.

reply.rationale: Merged and trimmed beats (dropped the closing pack shot) so six action lines at 2 s plus the 6-word VO at 2.4 s total about 14.4 s.
